title: Smiling Sisters, Matching Frilled Dresses - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A touching mid-century studio portrait of two young sisters posing together in front of a pleated fabric curtain. The older girl, wearing pigtails with clips, hugs her younger sister tightly with a cheerful, toothy smile, while the toddler gazes outward with wide, curious eyes. Both girls are dressed in identical frilled dresses with delicate lace-trimmed collars and ruffled puff sleeves, a classic style of mid-1950s American children's formal wear. The back of the photo shows a stamped processing number '701' on Kodak Velox paper.
